audience: attorneys and in-house legal teams who need a quick, cited first pass on a research question
hackathon judges and teammates looking at how the agents coordinate
coding agents working in this repository
problem: A research answer that cites a case nobody retrieved, or quotes a passage that does not exist, is worse than no answer. Multi-agent pipelines make this harder to see, because each agent hands work to the next without a record of who did what.
solution: Precedent splits one question across four agents (planner, retriever, answer, safeguard). Each claims a seat, logs its steps, and hands off; the safeguard rejects drafts that cite anything outside the retrieved set.
mechanism: retriever: seed authorities, Octo passage search, one-hop citation expansion, PageRank ranking
answer: short memo from the numbered authorities only, through InferHub, then Anthropic, then a plain template
safeguard: deterministic checks on citations, unknown authorities and uncited sentences
every step is written to runs/<run_id>/events.jsonl and claimed in .coord/assignment.json

evidence.claim: Four agents run each question: planner, retriever, answer and safeguard.
evidence.source: agents.py, functions run_pipeline, retriever, answer, safeguard
evidence.supports: The pipeline code claims a seat for each of the four roles and hands off in that order.
evidence.limits: Shows the code path; it does not show answer quality on any given question.

evidence.claim: The safeguard fails a draft that cites a reference outside the retrieved set or names an unknown authority.
evidence.supports: check_refs and check_named compare the draft against the retrieved citations; pass requires no invalid or unknown references and at least one citation.
evidence.limits: These are pattern checks. They do not verify that a quote is a fair reading of the case.

evidence.claim: When every model call fails, the answer step returns a plain template instead of an invented memo.
evidence.supports: complete() falls back to the caller's template and labels the provider as template.
evidence.limits: The template lists authorities; it is not a substitute for a drafted memo.

evidence.claim: The graph store falls back from SurrealDB to NetworkX over local files.
evidence.supports: Graph() sets backend to networkx when SurrealDB is not reachable and reads nodes.jsonl and edges.jsonl.
evidence.limits: Needs the case data on disk; the data is not in the repository.

evidence.claim: Deploys to the Pro are health-checked and roll back on failure.
evidence.supports: deploy.sh resets to origin/main, restarts the launchd job, checks local and public /api/health, and switches back to the previous commit if the check fails.
evidence.limits: It refuses to run over uncommitted changes in ~/precedent, so a dirty checkout blocks deploys until someone cleans it up.

boundaries: Precedent is a research aid, not legal advice; every answer carries a disclaimer
The case data (data/nodes.jsonl, edges.jsonl) and the Octo snapshot are not in the repository
The helper writing system is pinned by commit and never vendored here
Merging a PR does not by itself prove the Pro deployed it; check the deploy run and /api/health
